ScannedDocument.title: ScannedDocument
ScannedDocument.description: A scanned site or office document with Gemini Vision OCR transcript, structured metadata, dual date indexing, and searchable PDF reference.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document path.

documentDateIso.description: Date written or printed on the document in YYYY-MM-DD format, or empty string if blank on the form.

filedDateIso.description: Date the document was filed in DocFolio in YYYY-MM-DD format.

referenceNumber.description: Slip number, form code, or challan reference (e.g. 6717 / FCN-ST-13).

organization.description: Issuing company or project name (e.g. Kalpataru Projects International Ltd.).

contractorOrParty.description: Sub-contractor, department, scheme name, or counterparty.

summary.description: Concise summary of extracted items, quantities, or inspection status.

extractedFields.description: Up to 30 key-value strings extracted from tables and handwritten fields.

ocrFullText.description: Full searchable verbatim OCR transcript of printed and handwritten text.

localImageFileName.description: Relative filename of the locally cached full-resolution scan image.

localPdfFileName.description: Relative filename of the locally generated searchable PDF.

previewBase64.description: Compact compressed JPEG thumbnail encoded as Base64 for cross-device preview and PDF regeneration.

starred.description: Whether the document is starred for quick boss review.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/documents/{docId}.description: User-owned scanned documents indexed by filed date, document date, and OCR full text.
